about: Pepper's routine sheet with two recent runs: one finished, one stopped while it ran. The dashed box is drawn by the capture, not the app: it lists each run row's text without the parts hidden from assistive tech, as a screen reader reads it. The routine is made through the routines route, run twice, and the second run is cancelled through its cancel route.

steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-panel-routine] button[aria-haspopup=dialog]'); b?.click(); return Boolean(b); })()
